name: Repair 2 review: t_p0 accepts pre-cast valid seven-digit input
source_basis: Added after reading repair 2, not a frozen holdout. Checks whether a previously accepted target assignment path survives. The source-valid TIME(7) maximum is pre-parsed by PostgreSQL to native 24:00:00, losing its original spelling; this is a target-interface regression check, not a live SQL Server observation.

name: Repair 2 review: t_p0 supports native hour extraction
source_basis: Added after reading repair 2, not a frozen holdout. Target API compatibility check: a time-valued column should retain the prior candidate's native time operations without a new application cast. This does not claim that PostgreSQL EXTRACT syntax is SQL Server syntax.
sql: INSERT INTO "TypeSmoke"(s_min,dt2_p0,t_p0) VALUES ('X','2025-01-01','12:34:56') RETURNING EXTRACT(HOUR FROM t_p0)::integer;
